newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal sets Lisbon holiday for Dec 2 OSCE summit.
newsitem.headline: Portugal sets Lisbon holiday for Dec 2 OSCE summit.

text.p: The Portuguese government on Thursday decreed Monday, December 2, a local holiday in Lisbon to coincide with the start of an Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) summit meeting in the city.
The decision means that the cash share and bond markets will not operate. However, futures trade is located in the northern city of Oporto and not affected by the holiday.
Local government officials will also be given the morning of December 3 off as the summit ends at 1300 GMT.
The move was made to facilitate the transport through the city's normally traffic-clogged streets as well as the security of up to 55 heads of state and government that may attend the meeting.
